\chapter{The master table and glossary}\label{app:canon}
Every constant and name in this book is taken from one file, \texttt{CANON/iam\_canon.json}; this appendix is generated from it.
\section*{The symbols}
\begin{center}\small\begin{tabular}{p{0.12\textwidth}p{0.8\textwidth}}\toprule
$A$ & reading $/$ the healthy or as-built reading of the same system, the same meaning in every domain; $A=1$ is healthy, $H_{\min}$ the floor below it\\
$H_{\min}$ & the floor: chips $k_BT_j\ln2$; qubits the material floor $\varepsilon_{\rm floor}$; cells the cell type's reference floor (Met-A) or $P_{\rm cell}H(\varepsilon_0)$ (IAM-A)\\
$\varepsilon$ & qubits: $-\ln(1-p_{2Q})$, the gate error in nats; cells: the per-molecule copy error\\
$M$ & $E/k_BT$ (cells $20.94$; chips $A\ln2$); $M/\ln2$ in Landauer units\\
$n$ & temperature exponent, $A\propto T^n$; calibrated per class, not derived; not $A$\\\bottomrule
\end{tabular}\end{center}

\section*{Names in use}
{\small\begin{longtable}{>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.24\textwidth}p{0.7\textwidth}}\toprule
name & definition\\\midrule\endhead
IAM's law & Every irreversible transition from quantum superposition to classical record pays k\_B T ln 2 per bit to the nearest encoding surface at the local temperature. \emph{Note:} the quantum-processor report/the semiconductor report Issue 002 used 'IAM's Law' for the performance-floor relationship; that relationship is now named the IAM floor.\\
Mahaffey number (M) & The drive ratio: drive energy over the thermal noise quantum, M = E\_drive/(k\_B T). Sets the operating regime and, with the architecture, the IAM floor. Cell: 20.94 (30.2 in Landauer units). Chips: M = E\_sw/(k\_B T\_j) = A(the semiconductor report) x ln 2. The only quantity named 'Mahaffey'.\\
IAM floor & Synonym of H\_min (the floor): the lowest error a system can hold at its temperature before thermal kicks win.\\
Informational fidelity ratio (A) & A = reading / the same system's healthy reading (the healthy reference), measured on the same instrument. Dimensionless; A = 1 is the system working as itself, in the middle of the gauge. Below it lies H\_min, the lowest error the system can hold before thermal kicks win; nothing reads below H\_min. Above 1 = more error than healthy. Cells: Met-A = mean H(beta) over identity sites / the healthy reference (purified healthy cells, same platform); IAM-A = H(eps)/(P\_cell H(eps0)). Qubits: eps/eps(as built), eps = -ln(1-p). Chips: E\_sw/E\_sw(as built). A is never the temperature exponent n. \emph{Note:} One meaning of A in every domain (2026-10-02). Before this, the quantum-processor report used 'A score' for -ln(1-p) (now eps) and 'wall ratio' for the ratio to the floor (now A); the semiconductor report called A the 'the semiconductor report index'.\\
Landauer metrology & Measuring how far above its thermal floor an information-writing process operates, against a fixed physical zero, in any substrate.\\
the methylation report & The biological (genetic) application of IAM's law: the umbrella for every cellular and organismal chain. Expansion as in Issue 002: Genomic Analytical \& Performance Engine. Chains under it: MethylPhys CPG (methylation, cells), the salmonid chain (in development).\\
MethylPhys CPG & A chain (tool) under the methylation report: Methylation Physics, Cellular Performance Gauge. Reads cells' methylation (Met-A, IAM-A) and places them on the gauge.\\
Met-A (Metrology A) & Array reading of ONE cell type in one specimen (chain v3, Stage M): Met-A = mean over the cell's identity sites of H(beta) / H\_min(cell), H(b) = -b log2 b - (1-b) log2(1-b). H\_min(cell) = the same quantity on purified healthy cells of the same type on the same platform, through the chain's own Stage 1 (constant Met\_A\_floor\_EPIC\_neutrophil; site rule Met\_A\_site\_rule); >= 90 \% of the identity sites must be measured. Whole blood: the denominator is the composition-matched healthy expectation mean\_i H(sum\_c f\_c mu\_c,i), with the specimen's own fractions f (Stage A, EPIC blood NNLS) and purified healthy profiles mu (no cohort; PROC-WB-NEUT-01); read when the neutrophil fraction is >= 0.20 (MIN\_READ\_FRACTION; DEV-LOWFRAC-01), below that the fraction is reported and A withheld. Stage T tare: against >= 3 healthy references run the same way (same slide, else same batch), A\_rel = A / median(reference A); with >= 20 reference records the noise-corrected tare A = a + b f\_neu + c N (N = noise index, mean H(beta) over 48,528 fixed sites; DEV-NOISE-02). The gauge state is printed on A\_rel only; without references the reading is reported as untared. Each reading carries its detection limit (smallest loss of the cell's pattern the specimen could show). Scope: neutrophils on EPIC v1; 450K and EPIC v2 refused. Normal 0.95-1.05. Information theory only; no energy content. Expansion: Informational Metrology A score.\\
IAM-A & Error reading: the per-molecule copy error eps of a cell's held methylation pattern on single-molecule sequencing (isolated unmethylated call between two methylated calls on a qualifying molecule), read against the physics floor at the cell's architecture position: IAM-A = H(eps) / (P\_cell * H(eps0)), eps0 = 1/(1+exp(phi*M)) = 0.032 (derived), P\_cell = H(eps\_healthy)/H(eps0), the healthy cell type's position on the floor, measured once on healthy cells with the same read-level pipeline and frozen (chain/Runtime Matrices/IAM\_A\_Positions/iama\_positions\_v1.json; neutrophils P = 1.099). Instrument effects cancel because reference and reading share the pipeline. Methylated (copy) channel only: the unmethylated (de novo) channel is dominated by bisulfite conversion failure. Holding energy E = ln((1-eps)/eps) kT. Normal 0.95-1.05. Expansion: Informational Actualization Model A score. Chain v3 Stage Q: P is valid only for the read-level pipeline it was measured on (neutrophils: loyfer\_pat\_v1, first 60 MB of each granulocyte .pat file); any other pipeline is refused until P is measured on healthy cells with it. A reading needs >= 100,000 opportunities; the two run-halves are printed separately above 50,000 each.\\
Salmon-A & Not a separate quantity: IAM-A read by the salmonid chain under the methylation report (body temperature = water temperature).\\
the quantum-processor report & Quantum computing report line.\\
the semiconductor report & Semiconductor report line.\\
EPLG [the quantum-processor report] & Error Per Layered Gate (IBM): the average error per gate across a 100-qubit chain running layered circuits, including crosstalk and idle errors. It is NOT the same quantity as an isolated median two-qubit error p(2Q) and must not be compared with one.\\
Floor ratio [the semiconductor report] & A(the semiconductor report) divided by the class floor of that architecture: distance to the class floor, not to H\_min.\\
C-score (sky-map C-score) & Third reading per specimen: clustering of a specimen's residual sky map (variance of 50-consecutive-site block means x 50, over the site variance), divided by the healthy baseline measured on the same platform and site set, so healthy = 1 on the same gauge as A. Two C-scores per cell, one per reading: Met-A C-score (arrays) and IAM-A C-score (sequencing; map of per-region copy error against the cell's physics floor). Catches damage concentrated in genomic regions that the averaged A dilutes. A cosmology map statistic (Methods from the Sky), not a physics floor. Development only; band not yet set. On first use in papers write 'sky-map C-score' (C-score is also an ecology co-occurrence statistic). IMPLEMENTED in chain v3: Met-A C-score only (Stage MC; clustering block from neutrophil\_reference\_v1\_1, healthy baseline from leave-one-out neutrophil maps). The IAM-A C-score is defined but not yet built. On the one gauge: C = clustering / healthy median, so healthy reads 1.\\
H\_min (the floor) & The absolute lowest error a system can hold before thermal kicks win; below it the system no longer exists as itself. It is NOT the denominator of A and NOT 1: it sits below 1 at H\_min / healthy reference. Cells (IAM-A): H(eps0) = 0.2044 bits, neutrophils at A = 1/P = 0.910. Cells (Met-A, arrays): not yet derived. Qubits: the material floor eps\_floor (calibrated; Helios on Ba+ at 0.13). Chips: the Landauer floor k\_B T\_j ln 2 (AMD 9950X at 0.0017). \emph{Note:} The absolute lowest point a system can operate at before thermal kicks win.\\
eps (gate error in nats) [the quantum-processor report] & eps = -ln(1 - p(2Q)), the two-qubit gate error expressed in nats; eps \textasciitilde{} p for small p. It is the qubit reading; A = eps / eps\_floor. \emph{Note:} Formerly called the 'A score'.\\
n (temperature exponent) & The exponent of A(T) = A(T\_ref) (T/T\_ref)\textasciicircum{}n: halving the temperature divides A by 2\textasciicircum{}n. One value per architecture class. CALIBRATED, not derived: qubit classes against published gate-error histories, chip classes against the 20-year published chip series. n is not A. \emph{Note:} Qubit classes: SC CZ 1.449, SC ECR 1.189, ion (laser motional) 0.612, ion (electronic) 1.200, neutral atom 0.351, NV 2.291. Chip classes: pre-Dennard 1.853, Intel 0.936, AMD 0.340, Apple 0.794, Qualcomm 0.500, NVIDIA 0.650.\\
Material floor (eps\_floor) [the quantum-processor report] & The qubit H\_min: the lowest gate error (in nats) a substrate allows, a calibrated class value per material (oxide-phase ordering Al/AlOx > Nb > Ta > ion in vacuum). Assigned by the quantum-processor report, not published by manufacturers.\\
Class floor [the semiconductor report] & A per-architecture lower bound on A(the semiconductor report) assigned by the semiconductor report (x86, Apple, ARM, GPU); calibrated, not derived. It is NOT H\_min: the chip H\_min is the Landauer floor. Floor ratio = A / class floor.\\
One gauge (convention) & Every score is an error score on one gauge: A = 1 is healthy in the middle, H\_min below it is the floor nothing passes, above 1 is more error; a failure point may lie on the high side (qubits: error correction fails near p = 1 \%). Each domain keeps its field's form. Always quote a value with its score's name. \emph{Note:} Adopted 2026-10-02: each domain is read with its own physics, so the formulas are not forced to be identical.\\
Healthy reference & The denominator of A: the same system's healthy reading on the same instrument. Cells: Met-A, the purified healthy cells of that type on that platform (EPIC neutrophils 0.330263 bits; constant name Met\_A\_floor\_* kept for the chain until the SOP rename); IAM-A, P\_cell H(eps0) (neutrophils 0.2246 bits). Devices: the device as built.\\
\bottomrule\end{longtable}}
